CITY OF SAN MARINO

Linda Mollno, Chairperson  www.cityofsanmarino.org
Liz Hollingsworth, Vice Chairperson  (626) 300-0777 Phone

  SPECIAL MEETING OF THE
  CROWELL PUBLIC LIBRARY
  BOARD OF TRUSTEES
  MONDAY, JUNE 15, 2020 AT 2:00 PM
  LOCATION CHANGED TO
  TELECONFERENCE MEETING

The City of San Marino appreciates your attendance. Citizens’ interest provides the
Board of Trustees with valuable information regarding issues of the community.

Regular meetings are held on the 4th Monday of every month.

In compliance with the American Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who requires
a modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the
Library at (626) 300-0777 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

  PURSUANT TO EXECUTIVE ORDER N-29-20
Members of the Library Board of Trustees may teleconference into the meeting without
noticing each teleconference location from which a member will be participating in a public
meeting.

  CORONAVIRUS DISEASE (COVID-19) ADVISORY
As a precaution to protect both staff, our constituents, and elected officials, the City is
following the State of California Health Department’s guidance on large
gatherings. Therefore, this meeting will take place via teleconference. Members of the
public are encouraged to watch or listen to the meeting from home, or provide input
electronically.

Members of the public may observe and offer comment at this meeting telephonically or
otherwise electronically:

  1) Public comment will be accepted by email to imcdermott@cityofsanmarino.org
  before or during the meeting, prior to the close of public comment on an item, to
  be read by the Board Chair during public comment. Lengthy public comment may
  be summarized in the interest of time.
 LIBRARY BOARD OF TRUSTEES – JUNE 15, 2020  PAGE 2 OF 4

  2) Public comment will be accepted electronically via the zoom.us teleconference
  module.

If you are an individual with a disability and need a reasonable modification or
accommodation pursuant to the Americans with Disabilities Act (“ADA”) please contact
the Library via email at imcdermott@cityofsanmarino.org or by phone at (626) 300-0777
prior to the meeting for assistance.

How to participate in the meeting from home:

  1) Via Computer for Video Streaming:
  Website: https://zoom.us/j/99987043071
  Meeting ID: 999 8704 3071

  2) Via Phone for Audio Only:
  Phone Number: (669) 900-9128
  Meeting ID: 999 8704 3071

  3) Submit Public Comments via email:
  Email: imcdermott@cityofsanmarino.org

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL:  Chairperson Linda Mollno, Vice Chairperson Liz Hollingsworth,
  Trustee Genevieve Chien, Trustee Lois Derry, Trustee Steve
  Domier, Trustee Mary Hsu, and Trustee Eldon Swanson.

POSTING OF AGENDA

The agenda is posted 24 hours prior to each special meeting at the following locations:
City Hall, 2200 Huntington Drive, the Crowell Public Library, 1890 Huntington Drive, and
the Recreation Department, 1560 Pasqualito Drive. The agenda is also posted on the
City’s website: http://www.cityofsanmarino.org.

PUBLIC COMMENTS

Section 54954.3 of the Brown Act provides an opportunity for members of the public to
address the Library Board of Trustees on any item of interest to the public, before or
during the Trustees’ consideration of the item, that is within the subject matter
jurisdiction of the Board of Trustees.

  APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  NONE

  BOARD OF TRUSTEES REPORTS

  1. CHAIRPERSON AND TRUSTEE REPORTS

  2. CRAIN ART GALLERY REPORT

  STAFF REPORTS

  1. CITY LIBRARIAN’S REPORT
  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the Board receive and file the City
  Librarian’s report.

  2. MANAGEMENT ANALYST’S REPORT
  None

  NEW BUSINESS

  1. 2020 MEETING SCHEDULE
  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the Board review the 2020 meeting
  schedule and adjust meetings as necessary.

  2. DISCUSSION OF NEW OFFICERS
  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the Board discuss the selection of a
  Chairperson and Vice Chairperson for FY 2020-2021.

  3. UPDATE ON THE LIBRARY’S RESPONSE TO COVID-19
  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the Board receive and file the Library’s
  report regarding its response to COVID-19.

  CONTINUED BUSINESS

  NONE

WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS OR PUBLIC WRITINGS DISTRIBUTED

All public writings distributed by the Board of Trustees to at least a majority of the
Trustees regarding any item on this agenda will be made available at the Library located
at 1890 Huntington Drive, San Marino, California 91108.
 LIBRARY BOARD OF TRUSTEES – JUNE 15, 2020  PAGE 4 OF 4

PUBLIC COMMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

The Library Board of Trustees will adjourn to a special meeting to be held on MONDAY,
JUNE 22, 2020, AT 2:00 PM from a teleconference location to be announced.

Dated: June 10, 2020  IRENE MCDERMOTT

MINUTES
  SPECIAL MEETING
  OF THE SAN MARINO LIBRARY BOARD OF TRUSTEES
  JUNE 15, 2020 – 2:00 P.M.
  VIA ZOOM TELECONFERENCE
CALL TO ORDER Chairperson Mollno called the meeting to order at 2:05 P.M. via the
teleconferencing application, Zoom.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE Chairperson Mollno led the Pledge of Allegiance
ROLL CALL  PRESENT: Chairperson Linda Mollno, Vice Chairperson Liz
  Hollingsworth, Trustee Eldon Swanson, Alternate Genevieve Chien, and
  Alternate Steve Domier
  ABSENT: Trustee Lois Derry and Trustee Mary Hsu
  CITY STAFF PRESENT: Community Services Director Josette
  Espinosa, City Librarian Irene McDermott, Management Analyst Robert
  Zubiate, and Librarian Rebecca Russell
PUBLIC COMMENTS
The following person(s) spoke:
NONE
APPROVAL OF MINUTES
NONE
BOARD OF TRUSTEES REPORTS
  1. CHAIRPERSON AND TRUSTEE REPORTS

  Vice Chairperson Hollingsworth directed City Librarian McDermott to share
  information regarding reopening libraries.

  2. CRAIN ART GALLERY REPORT

  No report was provided at this meeting.

ADMINISTRATIVE BUSINESS
  1. CITY LIBRARIAN’S REPORT

  No report was provided at this meeting. Chairperson Mollno requested that a report be
  provided at the June 22, 2020 meeting.

  2. MANAGEMENT ANALYST’S REPORT

  1
   No report was provided at this meetint. Chairperson Mollno requested that a report be
  provided at the )une 22,2020 meeting.

NEW BUSINESS
  I. 2O2O MEETING SCHEDULE
  Trustee Swanson moved to hold meetings on Monday, June 22,2020 at 7:30 A.M. and
  on Monday, July 27,2020 at 7:30 A.M. via teleconferences; seconded by Alternate
  Domier. The motion carried unanimously by the following votes: AYES: Chairperson
  Mollno, Vice Chairperson Hollingsworth, Trustee Swanson, Alternate Chien, and
  Alternate Domier. NOES: None.

  2. DISCUSSION OF NEW OFFICERS
  The Board discussed withholding the selection of a Chairperson and Vice Chairperson
  until new members are selected by the City Council, contingent on COVID- 19 impacts

  3. UPDATE ON THE LIBRARY'S REPONSE TO COVID.Ig
  Director Espinosa, Analyst Zubiate, and Librarian Russell provided an outline of the
  Library's activities in response to COVID- 19. Chairperson Mollno requested that a
  formal report be provided at the June 22, 2020 meeting.

WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS OR PUBLIC WRITINGS DISTRIBUTED
There were no public writings distributed.

PUBLIC COMMENTS
There were no public comments at this time.

ADJOURNMENT
Chairperson Mollno adjourned the meeting at 2:56 P.M. to a Special Meeting on MONDAY,
JUNE 22,2020 AT 7:30 A.M. to be conducted via Zoom releconference.

  ROB T ZUBIATE
  MANAGEMENT ANALYST
